for index, row in df.iterrows():
    country_group = row['Country Group']
    country_code = row['Country Code']
    series_name = row['Series Name']
    series_code = row['Series Code']
    
    # Extract the year and value for each year
    for year in df.columns[4:]:
        year_value = row[year]
        structured_data = structured_data.append({
            'Country Group': country_group,
            'Country Code': country_code,
            'Series Name': series_name,
            'Series Code': series_code,
            'Year': year,
            'Value': year_value
        }, ignore_index=True)

education_expenditure_data = structured_data[structured_data['Series Name'] == 'Adjusted savings: education expenditure (percentage of GNI)']

    series_name = row['Series Name']
    series_code = row['Series Code']
    
    # Extract the year and value for each year
    for year in df.columns[4:]:
        year_value = row[year]
        structured_data = pd.concat([structured_data, pd.DataFrame({
